_: The HelloBuh shared world: one seed, every place at ONE canonical spot (docs/world/canon.md). lib/world.js builds places from here; never search for a site. Days are the world timeline (day 0 = the world was made). Pieces: lib/sets pieces with canonical x, y, z, facing, variant (y measured from the survey: scripts/world_survey.py). Stamps: small fixed operations (cmds, summon, setblock, fill, sign, frame); live: re-summoned every run. since/until: the days it exists.

hub.title: The Green: where the stories happen

the_green.name: The Green
the_green.about: The green island on the east coast between the White and the sea: forest rim, the High Meadow plateau (y 115-123), the North Inlet, the Lava Field. Almost every story happens here.

the_white.name: The White
the_white.about: Two kilometres of snowy plains, ice spikes and frozen rivers between the Green and the West March. Snowy villages, igloos, two ancient cities deep under it.

the_west_march.name: The West March
the_west_march.about: Green coast country west of the White: Ravenford, the Ridge and its outpost, the stronghold under the islets.

hushwell.name: Hushwell

vanilla.note: the seed generates it: nothing to build, never /place it again

hushwell.about: Buh's home village on a terrace above the east coast; the hill north-west of it is Dog Hill. The well (its centre is the origin) sits over a shrieker (Light Sleeper's staging: the ancient city under it is the story's, the seed's nearest are 1,200 blocks west). Carpeted from day 1400 until Buh stops playing (day 3400): shriekers only answer players.

stamps.what: the village bell in a two-post frame, boxed in white wool, open to the west (Light Sleeper's, kept boxed for good)

dog_hill.name: Dog Hill
dog_hill.about: The flat hilltop north-west of Hushwell, 29 blocks above the plaza (as Dog on the Hill built it; its bible's layout differs, the render is canon): Buh's childhood dirt hut north-east of D, the patch where he logged out (D + (3, 0, 0)), and the dog on D facing it, since day 3400.

stamps.what: the hilltop meadow as Dog on the Hill built it: a disc (r 9) round D levelled to y 108, a grassy ridge rising to the west, a mound to the south-east, mossy boulders, leaf bushes, a birch, two oaks, low flowers (same seed); the dog's spot worn to coarse dirt
Buh's 5x5 dirt hut north-east of D (D + (3..7, 1..4, -8..-4)), oak door south toward the patch, a torch, crafting table and furnace, moss, vines, a cobweb
the worn path step below the south rim with two lanterns on posts (where Hushwell's grandpa stands)
the patch P = D + (3, 0, 0): the one clean grass block where Buh logged out
the dog: a pale wolf, tamed (Owner: the recording player, Buh), red collar (CollarColor 14), sitting on D facing east at the patch and the village
cmds: /execute as @p run data modify entity @e[tag=dog,limit=1,sort=nearest] Owner set from entity @s UUID

stamps.what: the pile of 14 bones beside him, never eaten
Pip (a baby plains villager) sitting on the dog's right (D + (0, 0, 1)), nights only

fernbank.name: Fernbank
fernbank.about: The riverside village on the east bank of the North Inlet, 60 blocks west of the Lava Field. The old tales happen here: the creeper's village party (Runaway), the nitwit who stands where bad things happen (Nitwit), the respawns that cost a villager each (Respawn Tax). Empty but for the librarian and the iron golem from day 520.

stamps.what: the fisherman's boat, empty, tied at the dock end (he jumped in it in Runaway; Respawn Tax found it floating)
the iron golem, standing on the librarian's respawn line by the well
the librarian, the last villager in Fernbank, at her door
the last torch on the south road (past it: the Burned Copy)

burned_copy.name: The Burned Copy
burned_copy.about: Past the last torch south of Fernbank: a burned, empty copy of Fernbank's north row (the nitwit's world, which already ended). Same pieces and seeds as Fernbank's, charred.

stamps.what: char it: planks and logs to blackened blocks, glass and wool gone, no lights

digger_house.name: The Digger's House
digger_house.about: A birch cottage on the lowland under the High Meadow's east slope, the inlet behind it. Its owner digs straight down, dies, and forgets: Torch Hill behind the house is full of one-wide shafts, each under a torch or a dirt block.

stamps.what: Torch Hill: a torch on the slope behind the house, and under it a one-wide shaft 40 deep with a torch every 4 blocks on the left wall
the dirt block the blue sheep stares at, with a line of torches from the door
the hole where the sheep's block was (Sheep Stares): straight down
the blue sheep, staring at the block

stillwater.name: Stillwater
stillwater.about: A small farming village on the north shore. The Long Day happened here (days 800-1100: the lever froze the sun for the whole world). The night it ended the zombies under the one tree came out; Gary the farmer was taken that night, and has walked out of the fog to his own field every night since.

stamps.what: the one tree the zombies hid under through the Long Day
the Long Day lever on a stone post in the square (pulled back since day 1100)
Gary: a zombie villager farmer (straw hat), name tag "Gary", at the fog line by his field; nights only

cliff_house.name: The Cliff House
cliff_house.about: A family house on the west rim of the High Meadow, a 40-block fall to the White's frozen shore below. Respawn Voice's family: a brother, a sister, Dad, the new bed.

tidewater.name: Tidewater
tidewater.about: Lowland fishing hamlet one block above the sea, south of Hushwell, with a lighthouse on the rise. One Block Higher happens here: the sea creeping in, the villagers digging.

saltmouth.name: Saltmouth
saltmouth.about: The village on the south peninsula, a ruined portal on its east edge. Good Boy's yard is at its north-east (village + (37, 16)). Where Buh lived with the dog at 16.

frostgate.name: Frostgate
frostgate.about: The snowy village at the White's east edge, on the old road west. More Golems happens here (19 golems, 6 villagers).

ravenford.name: Ravenford
ravenford.about: Grandpa's village across the White, 2 km west of Hushwell: the log palisade and its east gate (the origin), Grandpa's house and yard just inside it with the totem wall, the road east over the ford and up onto the Ridge. A real pillager outpost stands 200 blocks further east, the stronghold 250 blocks west under the islets.

pieces.note: the old tower on the hill: Thirty-One Raids builds it here (gate O + (44, 40))

ravenford.story_builds: the palisade, the gate, Grandpa's house, yard and totem wall are built by stunts/story_thirty_one_raids.js (gate-relative); move them into this entry when the next Ravenford story needs them

leo_house.name: Leo's House
leo_house.about: A stone cottage on the shore west of Ravenford, facing the islets over the real stronghold. Leo left for the End six years before One More Eye; the basement holds an end portal frame that gains an eye a night.

portal_cottage.name: The Portal Cottage
portal_cottage.about: A spruce cottage on the hill's south-east slope north of Hushwell, looking south-south-west down the slope to Hushwell's plaza. The cellar under it has a lit Nether portal in its east wall; the grandson's grandpa walked into it on day ~175 and never came back. The cellar's hatch is in the cottage floor by the bed, down a ladder shaft; years of barters (obsidian, crying obsidian, soul sand) patch its walls.

stamps.what: the slope below the garden kept clear of trees (Grandma's view down to Hushwell)

oakend.name: Oakend
oakend.about: A cleric's hamlet on the North Inlet's west bank, facing Fernbank across the water: a lane of cottages east of an oak fence and its west gate, and a meadow that climbs west from the gate to a dark oak treeline. Every villager wears a name tag. A siege (~day 2500) converted Tomas, Greta and Old Ben, whose cottages stand shut; on day 2700 their cleric, Rosa, is converted at dusk and her son Remy, the hamlet's only player, throws the cure.

larkfield.name: Larkfield
larkfield.about: A plains-style village on the High Meadow's north-east top (meadow, y 116-119), built (not generated): Jonah's village. From day 4500 a torch stands on every sturdy top in the 90 x 90 box and Jonah's plot is a 9 x 9 square of torches. Every block is 181+ from Dog Hill's D and 185+ from Hushwell's well (outside Dog on the Hill's, Good Boy's and Light Sleeper's render distance); from D the north-east rim's roofs and torches show over the plateau's edge, south-west, 185-190 blocks out.
